title: WIDGET / Android 12 : No more parameters
symptom: After changing to a POCO F3 on Android 12, the user cannot get the widget parameters anymore. Long press on widget gives only the size points but no parameter menu.
cause: The user suspects it is due to the MIUI 13 overlayer on Android 12 of their XIAOMI POCO phone.
evidence_quote: Probably it is due to the _MIUI 13_ overlayer on Android 12 of my XIAOMI POCO phone then :(
